faq.q: What are AI lifestyle product photos?
faq.a: They place your real product photo in a room, on a table, or in another everyday setting. You still review the result before you publish.

faq.q: How do I make a lifestyle product photo?
faq.a: Upload one product photo, choose or describe the setting, and download a square image. The credit cost appears before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the scene on a product page?
faq.a: Yes. Pair it with a plain product photo when shoppers also need an exact view of the item. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use.
Yes. Pick a room, a cafe, or a market moment, or describe the surface and light you want.

faq.q: Can I change the scene after the first result?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job with a different surface or prop. Each photo is its own 24-credit job.

faq.q: Does the scene replace my plain product image?
faq.a: No. Keep the original photo for details. Use the scene when you want shoppers to picture where the item belongs.

faq.q: Can I post the scene in a social ad?
faq.a: Yes. Finish the headline and the offer in your ad editor. The photo itself does not add your price for you.

faq.q: How is this different from a photoshoot?
faq.a: A shoot needs a place, props, and time on a calendar. Here you start from a photo you already have. Read [how to take product photos for AI](page:guide-product-photo-tips) if the source image is hard to read.

faq.q: Can I use the scene on a Shopify store?
faq.a: Yes. Download the square image and upload it on the product page yourself. Each photo is 24 credits, shown before you start.

faq.q: Can I post the scene on Instagram?
faq.a: Yes. Download the square image and add your caption in Instagram. Add any price in your own editor after download.
